Implement Spring Boot 3 MFA Service and REST Controller:
1. backend/src/main/java/com/kaapstyle/auth/service/MfaService.java:
   - Autowires TotpSecretRepository, RefreshTokenRepository, UserRepository.
   - generateTotpSecret(Long userId): generates base32 secret and otpauth URI for QR codes, saves TotpSecret entity.
   - verifyTotpCode(Long userId, String code): verifies 6-digit TOTP code using standard time-step (RFC 6238 HMAC-SHA1 algorithm), enables MFA if first time.
   - rotateRefreshToken(String rawRefreshToken): checks token exists, not expired, not revoked. Marks old token revoked, generates new refresh token and new JWT access token.
2. backend/src/main/java/com/kaapstyle/auth/controller/MfaController.java:
   - @RestController @RequestMapping('/api/auth/mfa') @CrossOrigin
   - @PostMapping('/setup'): returns TOTP secret and QR uri.
   - @PostMapping('/verify'): accepts {userId, code}, returns {verified: true}
   - @PostMapping('/refresh'): accepts {refreshToken}, returns new {accessToken, refreshToken}
